question: Should this PR use the narrow current-line Kova repair, or should release validation intentionally accept the demonstrated evidence downgrade from the older evaluator?
rationale: The artifacts prove the older green result accepts incomplete proof, while a matching forward repair now exists upstream; accepting the rollback would therefore be an explicit release-integrity choice.

options.title: Use current-line repair
options.body: Pin the narrow upstream fix after exact-candidate validation and retain the current evidence-integrity contracts.

options.title: Accept validation downgrade
options.body: Merge the older pin only if release owners explicitly accept `PASS` records with the identified missing proof.

options.title: Pause validation
options.body: Keep the authoritative performance lane blocked until the current-line repair passes the exact candidate.

recommendation.title: Use current-line repair
recommendation.body: Pin the narrow upstream fix after exact-candidate validation and retain the current evidence-integrity contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current pin and the matching upstream forward repair and are the strongest available owner for the release-integrity decision.
